summary.headline: Planetary Connections and Prevention
summary.text: Judicial astrology discussion of planetary connections: mutual dignities produce natural elevation and affection, while mutual detriment or fall produces denial and repulsion. It explains transfer and collection of light, planetary weakness from retrogradation, combustion, detriment, and fall, and prevention of light, with Saturn and retrograde Mercury in Pisces as examples.
